course_name_original: English 2, S03258 German 2, S03290 French 2, S03294 Russian 2
prerequisites: Foreign language course from the previous semester.

learning_outcomes.text: Achieve communicative competence in the students’ relevant subject area and future profession by building on the knowledge obtained in the previous semester.
Expand students' knowledge of the structure of the foreign language, the main grammatical categories, the specialized vocabulary and terminology of their degree course and chosen career.
Raise students’ awareness of some of the major features of the scientific style.
Prepare students for effective communication in an academic environment.

syllabus_topics: English for Academic Purposes: Description of Processes
English for Academic Purposes: Use and Analysis of information from Multiple Sources
English for Academic Purposes: Written reports describing trends and/or comparing data from different sources
English for Academic Purposes: Participation in discussions
English for Academic Purposes: Characteristics of the scientific text
assessment_rules: The semester is validated if classes have been attended regularly and ends with a formative assessment achieved through written tests and evaluation of oral tasks. Assessment is continuous.
